Robert C. Vick

Independent candidate for Governor, Tennessee · Open seat

Educator (former math teacher, coach, assistant principal, principal and athletic director)

Robert C. Vick is a longtime educator from Jefferson County who was raised in White Pine. He worked in Jefferson and Cocke County schools as a teacher, coach and administrator. He announced in January 2026 that he would run for governor as a "Christian Independent," and he is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot as an independent.

Where Vick stands

Education
Proposes "Rural Readiness," a plan to realign high school curricula with local industry needs to create direct pathways to high-paying jobs.
Economic development / Jobs
Says he will focus on connecting students to local industry jobs as part of his Rural Readiness plan.
Health care
Supports expanding health care access in rural areas and addressing the root causes of the opioid crisis.
State budget / Social services
Proposes applying debt-free personal finance principles from Dave Ramsey to state government, with priority on core functions such as education, infrastructure and safety.

Background

  • Educator in Jefferson and Cocke County schools: math teacher, coach, assistant principal, principal, athletic director
  • Known as "Dr. Vick" (the source does not say which doctoral degree he holds)
  • Raised in White Pine, Tennessee; lives in Jefferson County
  • Announced his independent run for governor in January 2026
